articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch classified payload for the U.S. Space Force
articles.summary: The mission is the third in a series of flights for the U.S. Space Force with a ‘TH’ designation in public filings. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled during a window that opens at 7:55 a.m. PST (10:55 a.m. EST / 1555 UTC).

articles.title: Live coverage: Arianespace to launch Amazon Leo sats amid rocket crunch
articles.summary: The Leo Europe 4 mission will the fourth flight of Amazon Leo satellites on an Ariane 6 rocket and the 16th launch for the constellation. Liftoff from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana is scheduled during a window that opens at 8:09 a.m. Kourou Time (6:09 a.m. EST / 1109 UTC).

articles.title: NASA seeks to begin ‘intergalactic freight network’ with $1.3 billion block purchase of rockets, orbital transfer vehicles
articles.summary: NASA announced the purchase of multiple modes of transportation to the Moon’s surface and cis-lunar space to help establish an understanding of what’s needed to execute on their Moon Base program agenda.

articles.title: Studying Cancer Cells in Microgravity
articles.summary: This Nov. 19, 2026, image shows gastric microtumors grown within an Encapsulates biochip.
